input.api: SendInput scancodes for keys; absolute mouse clicks work on the main menu

working.route: Launch: steam://run/98400. Window 'Hard Reset', class 'Hog Class', 1280x720 client (profile config).
Intro: Enter skips each logo film (Escape did not visibly); about 5 Enters reach the main menu. Enter at the menu screen brings up the menu panel.
Main menu: SetCursorPos + left click on a button works. 'Resume game' at client (636,288) in 1280x720.
After Resume: ~70 s of loading and comic panels, then 'Press any key to continue' (Space).
Console: Ctrl+~ (scancodes 0x1D + 0x29) opens it; type with SendInput KEYEVENTF_UNICODE, then Enter; Ctrl+~ closes. Commands typed are kept in s_console_commands_history in the profile config.
Close: open the console (Ctrl+~) and type 'quit', Enter. The game exits cleanly within a few seconds. Easier than the pause menu, which is drawn twice in side-by-side stereo.
Movement: holding W/S via SendInput scancodes walks the player (about 7 game units = metres per second forward).

hazards.claim: r_stereo_enable 1 freezes the window on its last frame (the game keeps running); a blind r_stereo_enable 0 did not visibly land. End the game with taskkill: stereo is then not saved to the config.
Do not name a helper script con.py (or aux/prn/nul) on Windows: python opens an interactive prompt instead of running it.
More than about 4 Enters at the intro reach NEW GAME -> New campaign; the next screen (difficulty) would start a new campaign. 'Back' is safe.
The game opens its pause menu when its window loses focus; Escape resumes.
r_stereo_enable is not saved between launches; type 'r_stereo_enable 1' in the console after each start.

config.shaders: loose edited .hlsl in <game>\data\shaders\ are compiled when r_shader_cache "0" is set (2026-10-07)
